# 👋 Welcome to Amar Batch Discussions!

This is the place for questions, ideas, and conversations about **Amar Batch** — the batch management app for Bangladeshi teachers.

---

## 📌 How to Use Discussions

| Category             | Use It For                                    |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| 💡 **Ideas**         | Suggest new features or improvements          |
| ❓ **Q&A**            | Ask questions about using the app             |
| 📣 **Announcements** | Updates from the developer (watch for these!) |
| 🙌 **Show and Tell** | Share how you use Amar Batch                  |
| 💬 **General**       | Anything else about the project               |

---

## 🐛 Found a Bug?

Please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/shahjalal-mahmud/Amar-Batch/issues) instead of Discussions for bug reports. It helps us track and fix them faster.

## 🧪 Want to Be a Beta Tester?

Email us at **mahmud.nubtk@gmail.com** with the subject `Beta Testing Interest`. We'd love your help!
